dataset: UCI Statlog German Credit Data (1,000 applicants)
known_limitations: 1,000-row dataset from 1990s-era German lending market -- amounts, norms, and applicant pool do not reflect any current market and should not be used for real lending decisions.

personal_status_sex and foreign_worker excluded from features, but other features (e.g. property, housing) may carry residual correlation with protected attributes -- a real deployment would need a formal disparate-impact audit before go-live, not just feature exclusion.
